m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>The gown is made from rich cassimere, giving it a fine depth and soft lustrous sheen. And the cap is quite stately. </ITALICS>\n
<ITALICS>The grounds of Ravenwood are decorated like never before. Colorful banners are everywhere, and a colorful array of guests as well. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>It is indeed a most festive occasion, and to think, it's all in your honor. </ITALICS>
Welcome, Wizard. It is my distinct pleasure to call you before great Bartleby this day, to recognize your remarkable list of accomplishments.
You have not been with us at Ravenwood for very long, yet you have had a profound impact on the school. Indeed, across the Spiral as a whole.
All of the esteemed guests who have gathered here today are familiar with your shrewd mind, your heroic spirit, and noble virtue.
None more so than your distinguished teacher, Professor Moolinda Wu.
My dear student, you have encountered many forms of Life in your pursuit of knowledge. Some bad, much good, and a handful that are beyond our realm.
I have but shown you the door to an infinite number of wonders in the Spiral. You are the one who stepped through.
Soon you will see it is more varied than we can ever imagine. I cannot wait for you to share your newfound knowledge with us.
Wizard, you've been more than an exemplary student. You've been an inspiration... and on a personal note, you've become a dependable friend.
And so without further ado, I hereby pronounce you a graduate of the Ravenwood School of Magic! With honors, even!
Goodness gracious! What happened? It looks like that chill wind has made Bartleby sick! But how could that be?
Such a landmark occasion! It's not every day we have a Graduation ceremony at Ravenwood! In fact, I can't recall the last time it happened.
I've had a cap and gown fitted just for you. Very elegant, I think. Put them on and step into the Tapestry to reach the ceremony grounds.
Headmaster Ambrose wants this day to be extra special! Many distinguished guests have come to congratulate you. Let's not keep them waiting!
Go ahead. Put on your cap and gown and then step into the Tapestry to reach the ceremony grounds. Everyone is waiting.
